name: Anvi Global Holdings, Inc.
summary: Anvi Global Holdings, Inc. currently has no substantial business operations. Its strategy involves seeking to acquire or invest in companies primarily within the mining, infrastructure, heavy earthworks, health services, and aerospace engineering sectors. The company's previous venture involved the sale of crepes. Incorporated in 2012 and based in Cary, North Carolina, the entity was formerly known as Vetro, Inc. before changing its name to Anvi Global Holdings, Inc. in September 2017.
